record.question: What do you mean by distribution of a drug?
options: The movement of drug from its site of administration into the bloodstream
The transfer of a drug from the blood stream to other tissues of the body.
The chemical conversion of a drug into metabolites.
The removal of drug from the body through urine or faeces.
record.explanation: Answer B: The transfer of a drug from the blood stream to other tissues of the body.. Distribution is transfer of drug from the bloodstream into tissues and body fluids. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK557744/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
